title: Mean Equicontinuity and Related Properties in Hyperspace and Measure Dynamics
summary: For a dynamical system $(X,T)$ we consider the induced dynamical systems $(\myper(X),T)$ and $(\hyper(X),T)$, consisting of Borel probability measures and closed non-empty subsets, respectively. We show that diam-mean equicontinuity of $(X,T)$ is equivalent to the diam-mean equicontinuity of $(\myper(X),T)$. Furthermore, we establish that $(X,T)$ is mean equicontinuous, iff $(\myper(X),T)$ is mean equicontinuous, iff $(\myper(X),T)$ is weakly-mean equicontinuous. For $(\hyper(X),T)$ the situation is different. It is not hard to see that the diam-mean equicontinuity of $(\hyper(X),T)$ implies…
